rows.text: XORs dword `01E0C2A8` with 1 and stores the result back; calls `002E0FA0()` and, when bit 10 (`0xa`) of its return is set, replaces the toggled value by 0; then tail-jumps (`00254FE0`+0x2F) with `ecx` = 0 and `edx` = that value (the toggled dword, or 0)

calls the functions at `0028E580`+0x0A and +0x0F; when bit 1 (value 2) of the second one's return byte is clear it passes `ecx` = 0 to the call at +0x2A, otherwise it calls `002E0FA0()` and passes `ecx` = 1 when bit 10 (`0xa`) of that return is clear and 0 when it is set; then calls +0x2F and, for `ebx` = 0 to 3, calls +0x4C(qword `0209BE80` + `ebx`*0x20, `ebx`)

notes: Calls to functions this page does not name are cited by site (entry + offset). Doubt: 0028E580's call at +0x0F receives whatever rcx the call at +0x0A left; the body sets no argument for it, so the sentence names no argument. Doubts: 1 (0028E580, minor).
